# Quotation -- RAUTAPORTTI-RFQ-2026-09

Visakoivu Oy, Jyvaskyla -- technical maintenance framework agreement

## 3. Eligibility

3.1 Visakoivu Oy holds a valid LUSA competence certificate.

3.2 Visakoivu's liability insurance provides EUR 2,000,000 of cover, exceeding the EUR 1,000,000 minimum.

3.3 Visakoivu holds sahkourakointioikeudet class S1, the unrestricted electrical contracting classification. Class S1 covers all installation types and voltage levels within class S2 and beyond, so the minimum-S2 requirement is satisfied.

## 4. Technical requirements

4.2 Service continuity through personnel changes is managed via cross-trained teams and documented handover procedures across our 62-strong LVI and 48-strong electrical departments.

4.3 Reporting to estate management follows a monthly format covering completed work, open faults and upcoming preventive maintenance.

4.4 Quality control and testing follow our NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system, with documented checks after each visit.

4.5 Statutory periodic inspections of electrical installations are scheduled and carried out per the required intervals, with certificates issued to the buyer.

4.6 Lift servicing is carried out in accordance with statutory requirements by qualified specialists under our oversight.

4.7 All technicians deployed hold the qualifications required for their trade and carry evidence on site.

4.8 Installed equipment carries a standard 24-month warranty from commissioning.

## 5. Commercial terms

5.1 We accept a price-index clause tied to an agreed cost index, reviewed annually.

5.2 A cost breakdown is provided in accordance with the required format.

5.4 Invoicing is monthly, itemised per property and work order.

## 6. Forms

6.1 A certificate of pension insurance payments is enclosed.

6.2 An insurance certificate is enclosed.

## 7. Quotation format

7.1 This quotation is submitted ahead of the deadline of 6 October 2026, 15:00 EET.

7.3 This quotation is submitted as a single PDF file, not password-protected.

## Liite A -- Tekninen erittely

2.1 We will provide training for the buyer's property staff on our reporting and fault-logging system at contract start.

2.2 Installation work follows a documented method statement covering sequencing, testing and handover for each work order.

2.3 Standard-stock spare parts are held at our Jyvaskyla depot; non-stock parts are typically delivered within 3-5 working days.

3.2 Visakoivu operates round-the-clock (24/7) fault-response duty within Finland, drawing on standby arrangements already in place under our current public-sector maintenance agreements covering health-service and school properties. This will be extended to cover this framework.

## Liite B -- Lomakkeet ja kaupalliset ehdot

1.1 Subcontractor costs are itemised for transparency where subcontracted work forms part of an invoice.

2.1 CVs of key personnel proposed for this framework are enclosed.

2.2 The confidentiality undertaking is signed by our authorised representative and enclosed.
